paper_cards.title: Total synthesis of apigenin 7,4'-di-O-beta-D-glucopyranoside, a component of blue flower pigment of Salvia patens, and seven chiral analogues
paper_cards.key_step: Sequential 7-O and 4'-O glycosylation from naringenin, with DDQ oxidation between the two glycosylations.

paper_cards.title: The efficient total synthesis of bis-glycosyl apigenin from naringenin: a greener way
paper_cards.key_step: Two regioselective glycosylations in a four-step route from naringenin without selective protection steps.

paper_cards.title: Total synthesis of three naturally occurring 6,8-di-C-glycosylflavonoids: phloretin, naringenin, and apigenin bis-C-beta-D-glucosides
paper_cards.key_step: Construction from di-C-glycosylphloroacetophenone by protection, aldol condensation, deprotection, and DDQ oxidation.

paper_cards.title: Total synthesis of flavocommelin, a component of the blue supramolecular pigment from Commelina communis, on the basis of direct 6-C-glycosylation of flavan
paper_cards.key_step: Direct 6-C-glycosylation of flavan followed by oxidation and 4'-O-glycosylation.

paper_cards.title: Total synthesis of agalloside, isolated from Aquilaria agallocha, by the 5-O-glycosylation of flavan
paper_cards.key_step: 5-O-glycosylation of a flavan with glycosyl fluoride, followed by DDQ oxidation and deprotection.

paper_cards.title: Total synthesis of the flavonoid natural product houttuynoid A
paper_cards.key_step: Nine-linear-step synthesis using Claisen-Schmidt condensation and iodine-catalyzed oxa-Michael cyclization, followed by flavonoid glycosylation.

paper_cards.title: A simple synthesis of 3-deoxyanthocyanidins and their O-glucosides
paper_cards.key_step: Chemical O-glucoside synthesis with explicit low-yield 5-O/7-O regioisomer formation as a negative selectivity control.

paper_cards.title: Regiospecific synthesis of three quercetin O-beta-glucosides of N-acetylglucosamine
paper_cards.key_step: Regiospecific chemical preparation of three quercetin O-glycoside positional isomers.

paper_cards.title: Directed evolution of a plant glycosyltransferase for chemo- and regioselective glycosylation of pharmaceutically significant flavonoids
paper_cards.key_step: Directed evolution of a plant glycosyltransferase to alter chemo- and regioselective flavonoid glycosylation.

paper_cards.title: Functional characterization, structural basis, and regio-selectivity control of a promiscuous flavonoid 7,4'-di-O-glycosyltransferase from Ziziphus jujuba var. spinosa
paper_cards.key_step: ZjOGT3 sequentially catalyzes 4'- and 7-O glycosylation and selectively catalyzes 7-O glycosylation of 7,4'-dihydroxyflavanones.

paper_cards.title: Synthesis of hesperetin 7-O-glucoside from flavonoids extracted from Citrus waste using both free and immobilized alpha-L-rhamnosidases
paper_cards.key_step: Selective alpha-L-rhamnosidase hydrolysis of hesperidin or neohesperidin to the 7-O-monoglucoside.

paper_cards.title: A novel and high-effective biosynthesis pathway of hesperetin-7-O-glucoside based on the construction of immobilized rhamnosidase reaction platform
paper_cards.key_step: Immobilized rhamnosidase converts a soluble hesperidin-Cu(II) complex to the monoglucoside complex, followed by ligand dissociation.

paper_cards.title: Glycosylation of hesperetin by plant cell cultures
paper_cards.key_step: Cultured Eucalyptus perriniana and Ipomoea batatas cells glycosylate hesperetin, including regioselective formation of the 7-O-beta-D-glucoside.

paper_cards.title: The molecular and enzymatic basis of bitter/non-bitter flavor of citrus fruit: evolution of branch-forming rhamnosyltransferases under domestication
paper_cards.key_step: Cs1,6RhaT-expressing tobacco BY-2 cells convert fed hesperetin into a branched-chain product identified against a hesperidin standard; the enzyme directs 6-O-rhamnosylation of flavanone 7-O-glucosides.
reported_conditions: LC-MS retention-time comparison with hesperidin standard

paper_cards.title: Glycosides and Oligosaccharides in the L-Rhamnose Series. Part IV. Synthesis of Naringin and Neohesperidin
paper_cards.key_step: The introduction summarizes the 1943 hesperidin synthesis as condensation of a named acetylated alpha-L-rutinosyl bromide with hesperetin followed by alkaline deacetylation.

reaction_lessons.title_zh: ZjOGT3 催化的黄酮 O-糖基化
reaction_lessons.principle_zh: 糖基转移酶以 UDP-糖为供体，将糖基转移到黄酮羟基；位点选择取决于底物结构与酶微环境，不能把一个底物的 4'-O/7-O 结果外推到全部黄酮。
reaction_lessons.principle_en: The UDP-dependent glycosyltransferase transfers a sugar to a flavonoid hydroxyl. Regioselectivity depends on substrate structure and the enzyme environment and cannot be generalized from one substrate to every flavonoid.
